value.text:
All Saints University Lango (ASUL), also known as All Saints University, is a private university in Uganda. Its campus is on Adoko Road in the southeastern part of Lira, in Lira District in the Northern Region, approximately 320 kilometres by road north of Kampala. The university is recognised by the Uganda National Council for Higher Education, and its courses are described as accredited by that council. Its motto is “Enlightenment with Godliness”.

The university was founded in 2008 by the Diocese of Lango of the Church of Uganda. Its first class, comprising 90 undergraduate students, was admitted in January 2009. Although its founders and administrators are Christians, admission is described as open without regard to nationality, religious beliefs or ethnicity.

As of January 2015, ASUL maintained three faculties: Business Administration and Management, Social Science, and Education. Listed bachelor’s programmes cover business administration, entrepreneurship and small business management, primary and secondary education, social sciences, social work and social administration, and project planning and management. Diploma and certificate courses are also offered in these or related fields. The reported institutional scale for 2010 was 300 or more students and 26 or more administrative staff.
